text:
marta: getting a ton of dcgm_exporter flapping alerts for the us-west-gpu pool since the scheduler rollout ~2h ago. Prom is spamming us, 30+ restarts in 10m :grimacing:
omar: can you paste a sample pod name and last failure log? which nodes?
marta: pod/gpu-metrics-dcgm-8x7q on ip-10-2-14-21.us-west-1 — last lines from container log:
```
I0321 10:23:38 dcgm_exporter.go:87] initializing NVML
E0321 10:23:38 dcgm_exporter.go:92] nvml Init() failed: NVML_ERROR_DRIVER_NOT_LOADED
panic: nvml unavailable
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.main()
	/opt/dcgm-exporter/main.go:112 +0x1f3
exit status 2
```
looks like NVML isn't available at container start, then kube restarts the pod. nodes show kubelet restarts too.
ryan: that error usually means the GPU driver module isn't ready on the host (or node rebooted) — could be eviction/cordon churn from the scheduler change. any node events?
marta: k describe node snippet:
```
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From     Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----     -------
  Warning KernelEviction  10m  kubelet  Memory pressure hard eviction threshold met
  Normal  NodeRebooted    9m   kubelet  Node rebooted by cluster-autoscaler
```
jess: we flipped the binpacking scheduler tweak 2h ago (reduces spread to save GPUs). looks like on nodes with high IO it caused kernel oom + reboots. i'll rollback the scheduler tweak on us-west-gpu.
omar: short-term mitigations we can push: 1) change dcgm-exporter livenessProbe to less aggressive (periodSeconds: 30, initialDelaySeconds: 60) so brief driver hiccups don't trigger immediate restarts; 2) add a Prometheus alert suppression: for: 5m or bump alert to 10m to reduce pager noise; 3) add a node-exporter alert to track kernel oom events so we correlate.
marta: +1 on probe change, we should also add a one-off grafana panel for nvml init failures to trace. i'll patch dcgm deployment in us-west-gpu now, then monitor.
infra-bot: deploy/kube-system/scheduler-configmap rolled out by jess at 1769452000 — see CI job link: https://ci.internal/repo/2934 (automated message)
omar: prometheus rule suggestion (short):
```
- alert: DCGMExporterFlapping
  expr: increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{container="dcgm-exporter"}[10m]) > 5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "dcgm_exporter restarting on {{ $labels.node }}"
```
marta: patch applied to livenessProbe and alert rule queued. will follow up in 15m with status. :thumbsup:
jess: rolling back scheduler tweak for us-west-gpu now, i'll post when done.
ryan: after rollback we should run a small soak test (10 nodes) and watch nvml/init logs + kubelet events for 30m. if stable, we can reintroduce the tweak with reduced aggressiveness.
marta: thanks — creating an incident ticket to track root cause & postmortem.
